subject: pharmacology
title: Sedative-hypnotics, anxiolytics and alcohol dependence

steps.tx: **Sedative hypnotics** enhance **GABA** inhibition at chloride channels and calm the brain in a dose dependent staircase. Rising doses move patients from calm through sleep to anaesthesia, coma and medullary failure in sequence. Benzodiazepines increase how often the channel opens and they show a ceiling that rarely kills alone. Barbiturates prolong each opening and open channels directly at high doses, so no ceiling protects overdose victims. Alcohol and opioids synergise fatally with both classes in community overdoses every year.
steps.say: Sedative hypnotics enhance inhibitory signalling in the brain and they calm patients in a dose dependent staircase. Rising doses move patients from calm through sleep toward coma and medullary failure in sequence during overdose. Benzodiazepines increase channel opening frequency and they show a ceiling that rarely kills alone in practice. Barbiturates prolong each opening and they open channels directly at high doses without any ceiling protection. Alcohol and opioids are a fatal combination with both classes in community overdoses every year in cities.

steps.tx: **Benzodiazepines** differ by half life, metabolism and route, and examiners test those choices repeatedly. **Diazepam** lasts long with active metabolites and suits smooth withdrawal tapers in alcohol dependence programmes. Lorazepam undergoes conjugation only, so liver failure and old age make it the safer choice there. Midazolam acts briefly and suits procedural sedation and controlled infusion in critical care units. Flumazenil reverses sedation at the binding site, but it precipitates seizures in dependent patients and mixed overdoses.
steps.say: Benzodiazepines differ by half life and metabolism and examiners test those choices repeatedly in papers today. Diazepam lasts long with active metabolites and it suits smooth withdrawal tapers in dependence programmes run. Lorazepam undergoes conjugation only so liver failure and old age make it safer there clinically indeed. Midazolam acts briefly and it suits procedural sedation and controlled infusion in critical care units daily. Flumazenil reverses sedation but it precipitates seizures in dependent patients and mixed overdoses in hospital settings.

steps.tx: Drugs for insomnia that favour the alpha 1 subunit induce sleep with less anxiolysis and dependence than older agents. They still cause **complex sleep behaviours** and morning impairment, so women and older patients need lower doses. **Barbiturates** survive only in niches such as phenobarbital for epilepsy and withdrawal protocols in specialist units. Porphyria forbids barbiturates because they induce the enzyme that drives acute attacks in susceptible patients. Buspirone treats chronic anxiety over weeks without sedation or dependence for long term users.
steps.say: Drugs for insomnia are designed to favour one receptor subunit and induce sleep with less dependence than older agents. They still cause complex sleep behaviours and morning impairment so older patients need lower doses prescribed carefully. Barbiturates survive only in niches such as epilepsy treatment and withdrawal protocols in specialist units today still. Porphyria forbids barbiturates because they induce the enzyme that drives acute attacks in susceptible patients presenting. Buspirone treats chronic anxiety over weeks without sedation or dependence for long term users needing therapy.

steps.tx: **Alcohol withdrawal** evolves from tremor and anxiety through seizures toward **delirium tremens** with fever and autonomic storm. A structured severity score guides symptom triggered benzodiazepine tapers and reduces total drug exposure in hospital. Thiamine always precedes glucose because glucose without thiamine can precipitate Wernicke injury in malnourished drinkers suddenly. Relapse prevention combines counselling with acamprosate, naltrexone or supervised disulfiram for selected motivated patients after detoxification. Each untreated withdrawal kindles the next, so early adequate treatment protects the brain long term.
steps.say: Alcohol withdrawal is a progressive syndrome that evolves from tremor and anxiety through seizures toward a dangerous delirious state with autonomic storm. A structured severity score guides symptom triggered tapers and it reduces total drug exposure in hospital wards. Thiamine always precedes glucose because glucose alone can precipitate brain injury in malnourished drinkers presenting acutely unwell. Relapse prevention combines counselling with medicines that reduce craving or block reward after detoxification finishes safely at home. Each untreated withdrawal kindles the next episode so early adequate treatment protects the brain long term.

steps.tx: This bedside photograph shows a tremulous sweating patient whose monitor displays tachycardia and hypertension during **alcohol withdrawal**. The nurse scores severity on a structured **CIWA** chart and gives benzodiazepine only when symptoms cross the trigger level. That symptom triggered method treats the autonomic storm while avoiding continuous oversedation in a monitored bed. The labels also warn that delirium tremens carries real mortality without prompt treatment and close observation. Thiamine before glucose completes the examination answer beside the chart in this scene.
